rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a distinctive characteristic of a person, group, or system.

example.english: Using salted lemon with milk tea is this diner’s idiosyncrasy.
example.traditional: 呢間茶餐廳用咸檸檬配奶茶，係佢哋嘅特點。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 jung6 haam4 ning4 mung1 pui3 naai5 caa4 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 dak6 dim2

rows.note: Use this when the idiosyncrasy is specifically a person's or group's recurring behavior or way of doing things.

example.english: My dad always has a sip of soup before eating; that habit is his idiosyncrasy.
example.traditional: 我阿爸食飯之前一定要飲啖湯，呢個習慣成家人都知。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 baa4 sik6 faan6 zi1 cin4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jam2 daam6 tong1 ni1 go3 zaap6 gwaan3 sing4 gaa1 jan4 dou1 zi1

rows.note: Use this when the peculiarity is an odd or eccentric personal quirk rather than a neutral distinguishing feature.

example.english: They have an idiosyncrasy of counting every shirt button from top to bottom before going out.
example.traditional: 佢出街一定要將衫鈕扣由上至下逐粒數一次，呢個怪癖真係幾難明。
